items.title: What Does Abbott Laboratories (ABT) FDA Clearance Mean For Its Diabetes Device Push?
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) received FDA De Novo authorization for its Libre Duo 10 Day, described as the first dual glucose ketone monitoring wearable for U.S. patients. The Libre Duo 10 Day is cleared for use in people with diabetes as young as age 2 and is intended to support real time tracking of both glucose and ketone levels. items.title: FDA Approves Abbott's First Wearable Device for Dual Ketone and Glucose Tracking
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on Tuesday approved Abbott Laboratories’ (NYSE:ABT) Libre Duo 10 Day Continuous Dual Glucose Ketone Monitoring System for diabetes patients aged two and older. The regulatory nod makes the device the first wearable in the U.S. to monitor ketone levels continuously.
